sloka: अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् प्रातर् एव अपरे अहनि ।वन्दिनः पर्युपातिष्ठम्स् तत् पार्थिव निवेशनम् ॥२-६५-१॥
transliteration: atha rātryām vyatītāyām prātar eva apare ahani ।vandinaḥ paryupātiṣṭhams tat pārthiva niveśanam ॥2-65-1॥

translations.english: Then on the following day (unaware of Dasaratha's death) panegyrists uttering benedictions, highly accomplished bards and genealogists proficient in reciting auspicious words, singers versed in musical science reached the palace one after another eulogising the king's glory.
